puzzles.title: Tell the story of the island

copy.instructions: Talk to Flint, then follow the glowing path to the mountain.
copy.loading: Hiking up to the Heart of Firepeak.

returns.label: Step through the portal back to Explorer's Landing

zones.enterMessage: Flint: Welcome to Firepeak! Use the stick or the arrow keys to walk. Say hello to me, then read the map.
Tip: You can press Jump to hop over this log. Jumping is just for fun. You can always walk around.
Emberwood Forest. Kindle the fire spirit is here to help. Hop the logs or walk around them.
The Lava Crossing. Solve the stone numbers to build a bridge. If you slip, you just go back to a safe spot.
The Crystal Caverns. Professor Basalt knows all about these rocks. The crystals glow!
The Ancient Forge. Cinder keeps the old machines. Can you wake them up?
Firepeak Summit. Climb the steps, or take the hopping stones if you like.
The Heart Chamber. The Heart of Firepeak is dim. Set the crystals in order to wake it.
